from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityEnrollment(BaseModel):
    """Enrollment data for one university from a CDS report."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university as named in the document")
    undergraduate_count: int | None = Field(description="Total number of undergraduate students (numerator for ratio)")
    grand_total_enrollment: int | None = Field(description="Grand total enrollment of all students (denominator for ratio)")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period/date in YYYY-MM format", examples=["2021-09", "2021-10"])
    cds_section: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section where this data appears, e.g. 'B1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_enrollments: list[UniversityEnrollment]
